notes.title: New Content 2022
notes.notes:
Hello mighty warriors!

A massive number of newcomers have come from all around the world to the evil kingdom of the darkness. The game is growing thanks to you all, and to celebrate I've created new content with a massive challenge with some more new features. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31804069/e79ce03fe894a7fb5d8f00301ea9064d70380de1.png[/img]

[u][b]"Breaking A Punished Soul"[/b][/u] is a totally new gameplay experience where you challengers will have to defend a discovered great gemstone until it is totally depleted by the miners. However you won't be alone, dozens of enemies have been attracted by the great shining precious stone and they will want to claim a piece of the cake. Challengers not only have to fight, but also will have to make their own strategy with swiftness in order to repel the mobs successfully. Do not panic, you can always request for the new useful supplies at the new guild store,  just make sure to not spend much on reinforcements or the gemstone will be consumed in debts.

-Fixed the levels where transition was affecting the light.
-Fixed an issue that was performing hits before time, combo transition now is smoother,

notes.title: In Darkness Further Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-cUf-caxVgrk/XJgAquXz0JI/AAAAAAAAA3I/Z_v3lbv7ZjcdHFSZxKMnEVrsiBiJwfqewCK4BGAYYCw/s1600/blogger%2Bin%2Bpages.png[/img]

In Darkness was created to bring a versatile game play experience to players who enjoy game genres such: action role playing, dungeon crawler, hack and slash, survival, rogue like, puzzle, space shooter, and many others. 

Developing In Darkness has been a real challenge, however it has been more challenging to show players the potential of the game avoiding to reveal the end of the movie. That’s why through this further notes, I’m delving deeply about some of the game features, some of its mechanics implementation, and what’s behind the story.
 [b] [/b]

                                    [h1] GAME FEATURES[/h1]

[b]Game Mode[/b]
The game has no modes of difficulty to chose from, however there are three different fighter classes that determine the level of difficulty in game. In Darkness uses auto-save system, each time character travels to another area, game is saved automatically allowing players to continue the game in the future if they want to quit game, or if their characters die. Also there’s an option to abort mission, in case players haven’t come prepared to complete a certain assignment.   

[b]Challenges[/b]
In Darkness is full of challenges, fights are based in real time, moreover, timing is crucial to survive in battles, dodging and missing don’t rely upon external factors like dexterity, but it depends on real player’s accuracy. Challenges are not only based on fights, but also on how to get information to clear levels, navigate mazes without map system, solve problems, discover patterns, etc. 

[b]Level Design[/b]
Maps are composed mainly of levels and sub levels; for example fighting challenges are played in short levels. While some retrieval missions are played in intricate hallways, which lead to another sub level. 

[b]Quest And Rewards[/b]
Each assignment has a degree of difficulty: for instance, there are some levels where some creatures could be stronger, or where levels could be larger. Reward amount varies according to the mission rank. Mission ranks are classified in [i]S[/i], [i]A[/i], [i]B[/i], [i]C[/i], where [i]S[/i], is the most difficult. Rewards are given when a certain mission has been completed successfully. 

[b]Character Customization And Damage [/b]
There are several ways in which players can see their characters change: by changing character’s fur; by trying the different armor sets available in game; by exposing the character to damage, since the damage impact will be reflected in the armors, so if the character reach a determined damage percentage, the helmet or the breastplate could break, if damage percentage drops to zero, the character becomes totally vulnerable. Another way players can see their characters changing is when blocking, doing so, characters take a specific ethereal aspect, and it may vary according to the potion they drink.

[b]Items And In Game Currency[/b]
Some creatures may drop random items as they are eliminated, also these can be found in the dungeons, but if players want to guarantee their victory nevertheless, equipment and potions can be purchased with gemstones at village stores, being possible to take some extras to missions. Gemstones either can be earned by completing missions, or by getting them in the dungeons. 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

                                   [h1]BEHIND THE STORY[/h1]

In Darkness takes elements from classic games like [i]Zelda II: The Adventure Of Link[/i], and [i]Ghost 'n Goblins[/i], such elements are reflected in several ways, for example:[i] Link[/i] carries a sword and a shield, and he can get magical powers, for this reason battles can become tactical. Furthermore, some levels in [i]Zelda II[/i] are complex mazes, and keys must be founded to unlock determined doors to progress in game. 

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-ITyqA27IcHc/XJbIcBiG90I/AAAAAAAAA2Q/UBk9aNTVaJIyhgRlj9MI6r92RW9XA-PcQCLcBGAs/s320/Z2.gif[/img] 
[u]Zelda II: The Adventure Of Link  (attack / defend)[/u]

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-UTpSp4JdAEA/XJbIobsilJI/AAAAAAAAA2s/qhCGx1rICrYPTZr5kQp86ZClIjsoA0Y7QCEwYBhgL/s320/IDS3.gif[/img]
In Darkness  (attack / defend)

In contrast, [i]Ghost 'n Goblins[/i] knight [i]Arthur[/i], must face gargoyles, dragons, the undead, a wide variety of enchanted creatures; his weapons are also varied, each one do its job, which makes it a tactical game according to the levels; another relevant aspect is when [i]Arthur[/i] is hit, he loses his armor leaving him vulnerable. Just to mention some few elements about these two classic titles that can be seen in the game, perhaps not too apparently. 

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-NzM4AHWQt94/XJbIgdpIVBI/AAAAAAAAA2k/0zmzc_EwH0g2dRHykvXRGNYSWfx9W1O-gCEwYBhgL/s320/GNG.gif[/img]
Ghost 'n Goblins (armor lost after has been attacked)

[img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-ce9pBpiF7Ho/XJbIlVKi84I/AAAAAAAAA2o/eoXGOCWQWoU7mWtudcOv6_5aMbubvarOwCEwYBhgL/s320/IDS1.gif[/img]
In Darkness (new armor after has been attacked)

The plot is based on the age of discovery, but also on[i] Homer’s Odyssey[/i], giving form in conjunction to a fantasy world, where brave warriors dare to adventure in unknown worlds, and who are subsequently doomed, since many of them will forget who they were, thus won’t return to their homeland anymore. Memory notes from those doomed travellers can be found along some levels in game, and such registered notes reveal more information about the travellers origin. 

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-3tzZrKkSx-Q/XJWPq-V8dXI/AAAAAAAAA10/-XvC2LBNDh8GxtmbfFNHmK97EI6PZWllgCLcBGAs/s1600/odisey.png[/img]
Circe Changing Ulysses' Men to Swine

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]ABOUT GAME MECHANICS[/h1]

In a very compressed way, In Darkness incorporates several game play mechanics from the genres mentioned above, moreover, it tries to take them a bit further. That’s the case of the items usage: commonly the inventory in rpg games, can hold up to 30 items, also characters can use the items without effort, for instance: players can spam a key or button to heal their characters instantly while they’re fighting a boss. The inventory and the items work a bit more tactical in In Darkness: slots are limited, and can store up to 8 items, the idea is to watch characters doing their things, and make feel players they’re also vulnerable, doing so, takes slightly more effort. For example, characters cannot heal during time battle, well, it is possible, but is too risky, because they must go through a process: first character’s weapon must be removed; then a potion from the pocket must be extracted and drunk; finally character’s weapon must be drawn again, that takes a bit longer, and don’t give much time to players heal their characters, if these are in immediate danger, so that’s another challenging factor in real time battle players can find in In Darkness.

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-O-6_jnxlwJY/XJbIo_oDL5I/AAAAAAAAA2w/B01Y-GIQJhsr5lWMKswf6ne9238-XcyYgCEwYBhgL/s320/IDS2.gif[/img]
In Darkness (healing procedure)

In contrast to other rpg games, dexterity and experience points are fundamental so players avoid missing hits or make their characters stronger, and sometimes that not enough, also  they must equip them with lots of accessories. The mechanic in In Darkness is based on right timing, this is, if players can’t perform a determined ability at the right time, obviously they will miss a hit. In Darkness doesn’t count on experience system, but it has a currency system (gemstones), if players achieve an assignment successfully, they are awarded with gemstones; with this currency, armors sets, and potions can be purchased to make characters stronger, but just like knight Arthur if he takes damage his armor is gone. Fortunately players can get additional armor sets and boosters, so such items can be taken to their missions. Earning gemstones is not difficult, and all assignments are unlocked and available from the beginning of the game, with the possibility of being accessible all time if players want to farm gemstones on a specific mission they may want to repeat. 

About space shooter games, there’s a special mission and it’s also available to be played at any time as well, this also integrate bullet hell, classic 2D space shooter, obstacle avoidance, but with some slightly difference: the perspective in which is played; the enemies that players have to face; being skillful is not really required, but there are lots of distracting factors that can stop giving players attention to incoming threat.

notes.title: Multiplayer Tournament (TBA)
notes.notes:
I salute all the warriors In Darkness, I foresaw through the eye of three twilights”: an invasion is coming!

First of all I want to thank the community In Darkness who have purchased my game already in early access, this is a big support for me and also encourages to work harder. I know you all have big expectations about the evolution of this game.

It’s has been around a week since I released In Darkness, and a new game mode was introduced already (Challenge Mode), that’s a good thing, nonetheless, there’s still a lot more I’d like to introduce to this game, and with more content to develop, the more things I have to work in, your patience is appreciated. 

So what’s next?

I’m doing my best to bring you something different overtime and my goal is you have fun and a good gameplay experience. That’s why I’m planning to carry out the first multiplayer tournament, where players around the world can show their abilities and compete each other in the fantasy world of In Darkness. I hope all players that owns In Darkness already, can join to this coming event, so more tournaments can keep releasing in the future. As we all know a multiplayer game just won’t work if there are not enough players to play with, so your participation is very important.


Stay tuned for more details.


PD: In order to avoid misunderstandings, please don’t get me wrong by saying multiplayer tournament with multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Challenge Mode Released!
notes.notes:
What’s life without challenges? Challenges encourages us to overcome them, and when we do so, we become stronger. Not matter how big a challenge is, just say:I can do it! 

Bring it on!

I’m introducing to In Darkness a new game mode, as I communicated in a previous post, this will consist in a serie of challenges, so currently I’m working on the first serie. In challenge mode you will be able to have a quick and wider view of what else you can expect to find In Darkness. I’ll post a short video of gameplay and will upload some few screenshots to Main Store. Stay tuned for more updates, you don’t wanna miss it.

Happy hunting! ːsteamhappyː

PD: Take the chance to get In Darkness in a lower price and take part in the development process while it is in Early Access.
